asks: my egg's gone, what do I do
egg is down am I safe
can I keep pushing without egg
say: With your egg down, farm from behind the wave and save your wall for a gank, or keep trading only if their jungler just showed elsewhere.
more: Rebirth is the reason people don't dive you. While it's gone you're the easiest target on the map, and one gank usually takes Flash as well.
You scale anyway, so a few quiet minutes cost you little. A second death here costs the lane and the next dragon fight.
If their jungler is seen on the far side, that's your short window to shove and take your trades back.
check: Is your egg back yet, do you still have Flash, and where was their jungler last seen?
breaks: Wrong if their mid is dead or recalled and their jungler is showing far away: then shove the wave into tower and recall on your terms.
basis: pro:A spent safety net makes you the target

when: the next dragon is more than two minutes away
asks: should I ult for a gank
do I save my ult for drake
is it worth using R bot
say: Use your ultimate on the lane with no Flash now, it'll be back before dragon, or just farm if the dragon is under a minute out.
more: A carry without Flash can't get out of a committed gank. Getting him behind now makes the dragon fight easier before it starts.
The trick is the clock. An ultimate spent with lots of time left costs nothing at the objective, and one spent late leaves you empty there.
If your mid has a long-range ultimate too, shove mid first so both of you arrive together.
check: Did that enemy really burn Flash, how long ago, and will your ultimate be back before the spawn?
breaks: Wrong if that lane is warded on every side or sitting under tower: then spend the time on camps and take the ultimate to the dragon instead.
basis: pro:Spend ultimates when the clock lets them come back

when: before 3:00
asks: can I gank at level two
should I go mid right now
say: Go at level two only if the target can't reach a teammate before he dies, or finish your camps if their support or jungler is near.
more: Your flag and lance combo is a real gank this early, but it has to kill at once. If he's knocked out of reach, their help arrives first.
An early all-in usually costs Flash from everyone who joins. Lose it and you've got no play-making for several minutes.
If it fails, go straight back to full clears. Farming is how you get those minutes back.
check: Is the target past the middle of the lane, does he have Flash, and can their support or jungler get there quickly?
breaks: Wrong if their support has already left lane toward mid: then clear your camps and gank the lane he left alone.
basis: pro:An early all-in must kill before help arrives

when: your bot lane is ahead in CS
asks: bot's winning, do I gank them
should I help bot or farm
my bot lane is pushing what do I do
say: Sit in the river behind your pushing bot lane so their jungler can't punish it, or dive with them once a big wave arrives.
more: A lane that's winning and pushed up doesn't need a kill from you. It needs nobody to arrive behind it.
Just being there lets them keep hitting the tower for plates. That gold comes without anyone risking anything.
If their jungler never shows, the crab on that side is yours and so is the first dragon.
check: Is your bot lane actually pushed up, is the river warded, and where was their jungler last seen?
breaks: Wrong if their jungler has just shown on the top side: then you're guarding nothing, so take his bot-side camps or start the dragon.
basis: pro:Covering a winning lane is a play

when: before 6:00
asks: both mids flashed, do I go
mid has no flash should I gank
say: Go mid now if both Flashes are gone, the first jungler there gets the kill, or keep farming if the wave sits on their tower.
more: When two mids with no dashes both burn Flash, the lane belongs to whichever jungler shows up first. Assume theirs is on his way too.
Come in as the wave pushes toward your side, so the minions don't give you away early.
A kill here usually hands your mid the push for the first dragon, so it's worth leaving a camp for.
check: Did you see both Flashes used, where is the wave, and is your mid healthy enough to follow up?
breaks: Wrong if your own mid is low and out of mana: then their jungler gets the kill, so stand behind your mid and wait for the counter-gank.
basis: pro:Two spent Flashes call both junglers

asks: he flashed do I flash too
say: Once he's flashed, follow with yours only if the kill is certain, or keep it and come back to that lane next clear.
more: Trading your Flash for his is a bad deal for a jungler. You need it for every gank, he only needs to stand near his tower.
His Flash being down is already the win. That lane is open for the next few minutes if you come back with yours ready.
Tell the laner, so he keeps the wave on his side until you return.
check: How much health does he have left after Flash, and can he reach his tower before you catch him?
breaks: Wrong if he's one hit from dead and far from tower: then Flash and finish it, because the kill and the wave are worth more.
basis: pro:A Flash for a Flash is a loss for the jungler

asks: where do I go early as trundle
their jungler ganks a lot what do I do
how do I play early trundle
say: Shadow the lane their jungler wants and pillar whoever follows him in, or keep clearing if he's been seen on the other side.
more: You win most early two-on-twos. Pillar of Ice can cut off the second enemy arriving, and Chomp takes away some of their attack damage.
Let their jungler start the gank. Once he's used his way in, he can't get out past your pillar.
Two early kills on you turn into a strong first item, and tanky melee teams struggle against that.
check: Which lane is their jungler likely heading to, and is your laner healthy enough to turn and fight with you?
breaks: Wrong if your laner is very low or out of mana: then the fight is really one against two, so take camps and let that lane back off.
basis: pro:Wait for the gank and answer it

when: before 8:00
asks: no lane is gankable what do I do
all my lanes are pushed in
where do I go if I can't gank
say: If nothing's gankable, take the crab and one of their camps so their farming jungler isn't free, or wait behind your pushed-in lane for his gank.
more: An early-game jungler who can't reach a lane is losing the race to a scaling one. Taking his farm is the other way to stay ahead.
The lane that's pushed under your tower is where he'll come. Standing behind it turns his gank into your fight.
check: Which crab is alive, which of your lanes is under tower, and where did their jungler start?
breaks: Wrong if their lanes next to that camp have push: then stay on your own side and full clear instead of walking into three people.
basis: pro:When lanes are closed, tax the farmer

asks: our top just teleported away, what do I do
top tp'd where do I go
say: When your top Teleports to a fight you can't reach, go collect his wave and guard that tower, or join only if you're already close.
more: His lane is empty the moment he leaves. If nobody catches the wave, their top takes the tower and the Teleport paid for nothing.
You get the gold and experience from the wave as well, so it's not a wasted trip.
Arriving late to the fight usually just means one more death.
check: Where is their top laner, how big is the wave heading to your tower, and how far is the fight from you?
breaks: Wrong if an objective is being fought over and you're the one with Smite nearby: then go there and let the wave hit the tower.
basis: pro:Someone has to catch the wave behind a Teleport

when: after 14:00
asks: where do I go in mid game
what do me and my jungler do
say: Move as a pair into their jungle for wards and a camp while mid is shoved, or stay on your own side if mid is pinned.
more: Two of you together are hard to punish and can take a camp quickly. One alone gets picked off.
Every ward you leave shows where their jungler is. That decides who gets to the next objective first.
If their support comes to clear, you often get his Flash or a kill, since your mid arrives before theirs.
check: Is your mid wave pushed past the middle, and how many enemies can you see on the map right now?
breaks: Wrong if two or more enemies are missing and mid is under your tower: then ward your own entrances and wait for the next wave.
basis: pro:Jungler and support move as one

asks: can I take his camps again
do I go back in his jungle
say: Switch sides this time, they'll be waiting where you went twice, or go back in only with your support and a pushed lane beside you.
more: An invade works because it's unexpected. After two in the same spot, their laners watch the timer and leave lane early.
The other half of their jungle is probably untouched and unwatched now.
If you're caught, you lose the lead you built and they take your camps while you're dead.
check: Did they ward that side after your last visit, and which of their laners can walk there first?
breaks: Wrong if their jungler is dead or showing on the far side: then the same camps are free one more time.
basis: pro:The third invade is the expected one

when: their mid is level 6 and your mid is level 5
asks: should I go into their jungle
their jungler is behind do I invade
say: Hold the invade for now, their mid arrives with an ultimate and yours doesn't, or take the far-side camps he can't reach.
more: A fight in the jungle is decided by the mids. One level here means one side brings an ultimate and the other doesn't.
Even a jungler who's behind wins that skirmish if his mid follows him over the wall.
Once your mid hits six too, the same invade is fair again.
check: Which side of their jungle is their mid closest to, and does he still have Flash?
breaks: Wrong if their mid just recalled or died: then go in at once and leave before he's back in lane.
basis: pro:Check the mid levels before you invade

when: you are level 5 or lower and a dragon is up
asks: dragon's up do I take it
say: Ping mid and bot and start dragon only once one of them is walking over, or take your camps and wait for the push.
more: Starting it alone without a lane moving tells them where you are. Their mid walks down and you lose Flash or your life.
Without your ultimate you can't fight your way out of the pit.
A dragon taken a minute later with a laner beside you is still the same dragon.
check: Are your mid and bot waves pushed, and has their jungler shown anywhere in the last half minute?
breaks: Wrong if their jungler and mid are both dead or showing top: then take it straight away without waiting.
basis: pro:No lane, no dragon start

when: before 4:00
asks: he's trying to back what do I do
he's low mana do I push
say: Push up and break his recall so your jungler gets the crab free, or just shove and recall yourself if you can't reach him.
more: A mid with no mana who can't leave lane can't help at the river. That's the moment your jungler should be at the crab.
Every recall you interrupt costs him another wave or forces him to walk back and base further away.
Tell your jungler it's happening. The window is short.
check: Is he recalling in a side brush you can reach, and is your jungler anywhere near the river?
breaks: Wrong if their jungler is missing and you'd have to walk past the middle to do it: then shove the wave and take your own recall.
basis: pro:An enemy who can't recall can't rotate

when: you are level 2 or level 5
say: Wait the few seconds for your next level before you go in, or trade now only if he just wasted his main spell.
more: The level you're about to hit often turns a slow into a stun, or gives you the ultimate. Going one minion early loses the kill.
If you commit Flash without that level, his jungler gets a free target in your lane for minutes.
check: How many minions until you level, and is he about to level at the same time?
breaks: Wrong if he's the one about to level first: then back off until you've matched it.
basis: pro:One minion early is too early

when: your lane opponent is a ranged mage
asks: what do I buy first back
I'm getting poked out what do I buy
do I tp back to lane
how do I survive this lane
say: Buy sustain on your first recall and walk back to keep Teleport, or Teleport if a full wave would die to your tower.
more: Against a mage who pokes, healing matters more than early damage. Reach level six without a deficit and you're ahead.
Teleport kept for the first dragon fight means your team has an extra player there and theirs doesn't.
If he spends his spells shoving for his jungler, that's when you trade into him.
check: Where will the wave be when you get back, and is the first dragon about to be contested?
breaks: Wrong if you're already ahead after an early kill: then buy damage and press the lead instead.
basis: pro:Arrive at six level with their mage

when: a dragon or grubs spawn within two minutes
asks: I just respawned do I tp
say: Walk back and keep Teleport for the objective if the wave is holding near your tower, or Teleport now if a big wave is crashing.
more: Using Teleport to save a few minions gives their laner the only Teleport at the next fight. That's an extra player for them.
A full wave with a cannon dying to your tower is different. That's worth the Teleport.
check: How big is the wave heading to your tower, and does their laner still have his Teleport?
breaks: Wrong if their laner already used Teleport: then yours isn't needed for the fight and you can use it freely.
basis: pro:A Teleport on a wave is missing at the fight

when: between 7:00 and 8:00
asks: grubs are soon do I tp
should I tp back to lane
do I hold teleport for grubs
what do I do before grubs
say: Walk back to lane and hold Teleport for the grubs at eight minutes, or Teleport now if you'd lose your tower without it.
more: Grubs come once and don't return. The top laner who can arrive decides that fight.
If yours is spent on the lane seconds before the spawn, your team is a player short and has to give them.
check: Does their top have Teleport, and which team's jungler is on the top side?
breaks: Wrong if your team is clearly playing for dragon instead: then use Teleport wherever it saves the most.
basis: pro:Keep the Teleport for the one-time objective

when: you are level 6 and their mid is level 5
asks: can I gank mid as top
do I use my ult mid
say: Shove the wave first, then walk mid with your ultimate for the kill, or stay and take plates if the wave would crash on you.
more: A top laner arriving mid with an ultimate, against a mid who has none, is usually a kill or a Flash.
It isn't free. Their top shoves while you're gone, and a kill can leave you only even in gold.
Pushing first is what makes it pay. Your minions die to his tower while you're away.
check: Where is your wave, does their mid have Flash, and is your own mid ready to follow up?
breaks: Wrong if their jungler is missing near top: then he takes your tower plates while you walk, so stay.
basis: pro:A roam is paid for in waves

when: an ally bot laner died in the last 30 seconds
asks: bot's getting dove do I teleport
say: Teleport bot when your own wave is already pushed, it saves their wave and a plate, or hold it if your tower would take the crash.
more: An early Teleport down there stops the dive and lets your carry collect a full wave. That's about a kill's worth of gold kept.
If you arrive first, your carry may even get a plate while their top is still walking.
You pay with your own lane, so the state of your wave decides it.
check: Is your wave pushed out, does their top have Teleport to follow, and is your carry about to respawn into a big wave?
breaks: Wrong if grubs spawn in the next minute: then your Teleport belongs there, and bot has to give the wave.
basis: pro:A Teleport can save a lane's worth of gold

asks: we're pushing but can't kill them
nothing to do bot what now
say: Crash the wave, then walk to river or mid to burn a Flash or drop a ward, or stay if your carry can't hold alone.
more: Lane control you can't turn into a kill is wasted if you stand there. Take it somewhere else for half a minute.
Forcing their jungler's or mid's Flash now sets up the next dragon fight.
Leave right after the wave hits their tower, so your carry isn't alone against a big wave.
check: Did the wave reach their tower, and where is their jungler?
breaks: Wrong if their support has an engage that kills your carry alone: then stay and ward river from the lane side.
basis: pro:Push that can't kill should move

when: you are a level or a kill ahead of their top
asks: how do I get time to roam
can I take waves behind his tower
how do I use my lead top
say: Catch the next wave behind their tower, then use the spare time to recall or roam, or shove normally if their jungler is unseen.
more: Killing the wave before it reaches the lane makes yours push by itself. That gives you time for a recall, a ward or a walk to mid.
It also denies him: his minions die where he can't safely reach them.
It's a risk you choose once, not every wave. Do it a second time and their jungler and mid are waiting.
check: Where is their jungler, is their mid in lane, and do you have Flash to get out?
breaks: Wrong if their jungler has red buff and is nearby, or their mid can walk up: then take the wave in lane instead.
basis: pro:Waves killed early buy free time

asks: do I back after this wave
wave's at their tower can I go
say: Kill the last ranged minions before you recall so the wave resets, or stay one more wave if they'd hold it outside tower.
more: If a few of your minions are left outside tower range, they keep them alive and freeze. You come back to a lane you can't walk into.
A full crash means their tower kills the wave and the next one meets in the middle.
check: Are all your minions inside their tower range, and is their jungler close enough to punish one more wave?
breaks: Wrong if you're low and their jungler is missing: then recall now and accept the freeze.
basis: pro:A half crash is a freeze for them

when: you are behind in CS and their top is a fighter
asks: I'm losing lane what do I do
he keeps beating me in trades
how do I play this lane as tank
say: Give up a wave rather than half your health and keep the CS close, or trade back only when your jungler is topside.
more: Your job in this lane is to still be a tank at the first team fight. A few minions behind is fine, a death isn't.
He wins trades now, you win fights later. Every minute that passes quietly is in your favour.
If he walks past the middle to bully you, that's when your jungler can punish him.
check: How far is the wave from your tower, and is your jungler anywhere near?
breaks: Wrong if he's low and has used his main cooldowns: then one full trade back keeps him honest.
basis: pro:A tank only has to survive the lane

asks: three of them are top what do I do
say: If three come for you, run to your tower and stall as long as you can, or fight only the one who's already low.
more: Three enemies on you means two fewer somewhere else. Every second you stay alive is time for your team to take grubs or dragon.
Ping the objective as you run. The trade only happens if they start it while those three are still on you.
Dying quickly is the bad outcome. Dying slowly with a tower shot on them can be a fair trade.
check: Which enemies are on you, and what can your team take on the other side right now?
breaks: Wrong if you have Flash and a clear path out: then just leave and keep the wave for later.
basis: pro:A collapse on you is time for your team

when: you are level 6 and their top is level 5
asks: I just hit six do I go
should I all in with ult
say: All-in the moment you hit six while he's still five and past the middle, or just shove and recall if he's hugging tower.
more: Dominus gives you bonus health and damage around you, and he has no ultimate to answer it.
It's stronger still if he's just used Teleport or your jungler is close. He has no way back to lane quickly.
A kill here plus the wave he misses is a lead you can carry into your first two items.
check: Is he past the middle, did he use Teleport or Flash, and is the river warded?
breaks: Wrong if their jungler is missing and you have no ward: then take the level lead as a shove and a clean recall.
basis: pro:The level six window is one wave long

when: you are level 5 and grubs are up
asks: I'm not six yet do I fight
say: Stay behind your jungler at this fight without your ultimate, or lead it if their support is level 5 as well.
more: An engage support at five gets burst down before the fight starts. With the ultimate you survive long enough for the team to follow.
One grub taken safely beats a lost fight for all three.
check: What level is their support, and is your jungler healthy enough to go first?
breaks: Wrong if a wave or the crab would get you to six in the next few seconds: then take that first and go in with the ultimate.
basis: pro:Don't lead a fight a level short

asks: their support's mid what do I do
he roamed do I go too
say: While their support is showing mid, drop deep wards in their jungle on your side, or follow to mid if your laner is already fighting.
more: You're often too late to stop the roam. What you can do is use the same seconds, with nobody there to clear wards.
Wards past the river show their jungler's path for the next minutes. Your jungler can gank or invade off that.
Ping your mid first so the roam doesn't work either.
check: Has their support actually been seen mid, and is their carry alone or back at tower?
breaks: Wrong if your carry is low under a big wave: then stay and hold the lane.
basis: pro:A roam leaves the other jungle unwatched

asks: how do I keep my carry safe
adc flashed where do I ward
say: Ward the three ways into your lane instead of going deep while your carry has no Flash, or hold the wave near tower without wards.
more: A carry with no Flash is the target every enemy with a gank ultimate is looking at.
River entrance, lane brush and the jungle path behind you cover the routes. Deep wards don't help if the gank comes from the side.
Do it until Flash is back, then go deep again.
check: How many wards do you have, and which entrance is dark right now?
breaks: Wrong if their jungler and mid are both showing elsewhere: then use that moment for one deep ward.
basis: pro:Wards go around the player with no Flash

when: their support is a hook champion
asks: how do I lane against hooks
should I use sweeper in lane
where do I stand vs hook
say: Sweep their brush ward so the hook can't see you, then hit them from the brush, or stand behind minions if the sweeper's down.
more: A hook needs to see you. With their ward gone, you trade from the brush and they throw blind.
Each missed hook is a free trade for you and your carry.
check: Is there a ward in the brush, and how many minions are between you and their support?
breaks: Wrong if their jungler has been seen walking to your lane: then leave the brush and play near your tower.
basis: pro:A hook can't land on what it can't see

when: before 6:00
asks: where do I put my pink
where does control ward go early
where do I ward after ganking mid
how do I track their jungler
say: After a visit to mid, leave a control ward in the brush by their buff, or keep it for river if a dragon is next.
more: A control ward there is rarely checked and can stay for minutes. It shows every time their jungler crosses that side.
Your laners then know when it's safe to push, without you having to be there.
check: Did anyone see you place it, and which objective is next?
breaks: Wrong if their support roams that way a lot: he'll clear it, so use it at the river instead.
basis: pro:One early control ward that stays up

asks: team's top should I ward bot
say: Stay with the team taking the tower rather than checking dragon alone, or ward it only with your jungler beside you.
more: When your team is playing the other side, nothing is being decided at the dragon. A support there alone is just a free kill.
You can't Smite, so finding them on it changes nothing.
check: Where is your jungler, and how many enemies are missing from the map?
breaks: Wrong if all five enemies are showing far away: then a quick ward on the way is fine.
basis: pro:Don't face-check the side nobody is playing

when: an objective spawns within 90 seconds and you have Teleport
asks: where do I ward before baron
how do I flank with tp
should I group or split before dragon
how do I help the fight as top
say: Drop a ward behind where they'll stand, then push a side wave and Teleport in behind them, or simply group if it gets cleared.
more: A deep ward turns Teleport into a flank. Their carries have to choose between you and your front line.
Pushing the side wave first means they also lose a tower's worth of minions while they wait.
check: Did they see you place the ward, and is your Teleport ready before the spawn?
breaks: Wrong if your team needs you in front because you're the only tank: then walk in with them.
basis: pro:The flank starts with a ward a minute earlier

when: an objective spawns within 90 seconds
asks: how do we get into river
they have a fed assassin how do we set up
how do we get vision for dragon
say: Shove a side wave so their one tank has to answer it, then take the river with four, or regroup if he ignores it.
more: A team with one front-liner can only walk into dark river behind him. Pull him to a wave and the other four have to wait.
Whoever is in the river first places the wards, and the other team has to check brushes.
check: Who on their team can safely walk in first, and does he have Teleport?
breaks: Wrong if their tank has Teleport ready and your side pusher can't get back in time: then go in as five instead.
basis: pro:Pull the only face-checker away

asks: they're taking dragon can we stop it
they got the dragon now what
say: Let them finish it, then engage while they're clumped in the pit and hurt, or walk away if your engage ultimate is down.
more: You can't stop it, but a team that's just killed a dragon is low, bunched up and has used spells on it.
Their jungler is often at the back of the pit with no way out. He's the first target.
Kills there can pay more than the dragon if a tower or the next objective follows.
check: Did they use ultimates on the dragon, how low are they, and is your whole team here?
breaks: Wrong if that dragon gives them soul: then you fight before it dies, not after.
basis: pro:The fight after the dragon

when: Baron is up and your health is below half
asks: should I heal on a camp
I'm half hp what do I do
say: Recall now and run straight back rather than walking to a camp to heal, or stay with the team if they're already on it.
more: A team with a fast objective kill needs only a few seconds with you out of place.
A recall brings you back full. A camp leaves you half healed and far from the pit.
check: Can their team kill Baron quickly, and is there a ward on it?
breaks: Wrong if three or more enemies are dead: then take the camp, nothing can be started.
basis: pro:The jungler can't be half a map away

when: between 7:15 and 8:00
asks: grubs are soon what do I do bot
where do I go before grubs
say: Shove bot and move mid before grubs so your mid can walk up early, or stay if you'd lose the tower for it.
more: With you clearing mid, the wave stays pushed and your mid is free to reach the top river first.
It costs a wave or a plate bot. Three grubs taken with nobody contesting usually pay for that.
check: Is your bot wave pushed, and can your top laner Teleport if a fight starts?
breaks: Wrong if their bot lane would take your tower in that time: then hold bot and let the team take one grub.
basis: pro:Lane swaps before the spawn decide it

when: your team took a dragon in the last minute and grubs are up
asks: do we fight for grubs too
we got drake should we go top
say: Keep the dragon and let the grubs go while your ultimates are down, or contest only if their jungler is dead.
more: You already got paid. The second fight happens on old cooldowns against a team that still has theirs.
Losing it gives back the dragon's value and more.
check: Which of your ultimates and Flashes were used at the dragon, and who on their team was not there?
breaks: Wrong if your ultimates are up again and their carry is still in a far lane: then go, you have the numbers.
basis: pro:One objective per set of cooldowns

when: Herald is up, a dragon spawns within a minute and the enemy has two dragons
say: Skip Herald and set up their third dragon with Teleports saved, or take Herald fast if they're already showing bot.
more: Their third dragon puts them one from soul. From then on every dragon is a fight you must take.
Herald is one tower. Don't spend the Teleports on it that you need a minute later.
check: Do both top laners have Teleport, and where is their jungler?
breaks: Wrong if your team has no realistic way to contest the dragon: then Herald is the trade, taken as they start.
basis: pro:Spend the Teleports on the bigger one

when: Herald is up and a dragon is up
asks: they're on dragon do we herald
say: Take Herald while they're on dragon but leave the second it dies, or skip it if your mid can't come with you.
more: The trade is fair only if you finish first. They kill theirs, walk up, and catch you still in the pit.
Watch the side lanes too. A tower lost while you hit Herald means you got nothing.
check: How fast can your team kill Herald, and is their mid pushing your tower instead of joining?
breaks: Wrong if their dragon is already nearly dead: then you're too late, take camps or plates instead.
basis: pro:A trade has a finish time

when: after 14:00
asks: should I go to the side lane
top wants mid do I swap
do I farm side as mage
is side lane safe for me
say: Take the side lane only with Flash up and their jungler seen elsewhere, or hold mid and let your top take the long lane.
more: The long lane is where the farm is, and where an immobile mage dies. Flash is your only way out.
Mid is short and close to help. You give up some gold there and keep your life.
check: Is your Flash up, where was their jungler last seen, and who's pushing against you?
breaks: Wrong if you're well ahead of the laner facing you and have wards down: then the side lane is yours.
basis: pro:No Flash, no long lane

asks: tower's almost dead do I stay
is it safe to take the tower
say: Finish the tower only if you can see three of them elsewhere, or back off one wave and let the minions do it.
more: A tower at low health is bait. They know you'll stay for it, so that's where they come.
The tower will still be there in half a minute. Your shutdown gold won't come back.
check: How many enemies are visible, and is the brush behind you warded?
breaks: Wrong if your team is starting an objective on the other side: then being collapsed on is the point, so keep hitting and stall.
basis: pro:The last hits on a tower are the trap

when: after 14:00
asks: where do I go as adc now
should I push a side lane
say: Stay mid and clear every wave so your side laners can push, or join a side only when a tower is about to fall.
more: Mid is the safest lane for you and the one that must never be lost. Holding it lets both side lanes go deep.
When two enemies leave to stop a side laner, that's when your team starts Baron or a dragon.
check: Are both your side lanes pushing, and how many enemies are showing mid?
breaks: Wrong if four of them are grouping mid against you: then back off to tower and let the sides take towers.
basis: pro:The carry holds the middle

when: after 14:00
asks: what do I do as yorick now
do I go to the fight
say: Stay in the side lane and hit towers while your team stalls four against four, or group only for a soul or Baron fight.
more: With the Maiden and your Mist Walkers you break towers quickly, and you're much weaker in a five-on-five.
Each time they send two to stop you, your team has the numbers elsewhere.
Dark Procession lets you trap whoever comes alone, or block the path and leave.
check: How many enemies came to your lane, and does your team know not to fight without you?
breaks: Wrong if your team keeps fighting and losing four against five: then group for the objective and split again after.
basis: pro:Leave the tower-taker alone

when: an ally carry died in the last 20 seconds
asks: they're taking our camp do we fight
say: Give the camp and fall back to tower while your carry is dead, or fight only if their ultimates were used and yours weren't.
more: One camp isn't worth fighting a player short. Stay, and one death becomes three.
After that they don't just take the camp, they take the tower behind it.
check: Who's alive on each side, and which ultimates were used?
breaks: Wrong if they also lost a carry in that exchange: then it's even and you can hold your ground.
basis: pro:A camp isn't worth a short-handed fight

asks: our support's caught do I help
he's getting killed do I go in
say: Don't walk in after a teammate who's caught deep, hold the nearest tower, or go only if more of you can arrive than them.
more: One player caught is one death. Each teammate who arrives late to save him is another.
Use his death timer for something. A wave, a ward or a recall is better than joining him.
check: How many enemies are on him, and how many of your team can get there at the same time?
breaks: Wrong if he has a way to survive several seconds and you arrive with numbers: then turn it into a fight.
basis: pro:Don't follow a lost teammate in

asks: we're all bot and their top is pushing
do we dive or go back
say: Send one player to the split pusher before you group, or take the tower fast as five and leave, but don't force a dive.
more: Five in one lane with no Teleport and no objective up means the clock is on you. Every second, their side laner takes more.
That pressure is what pushes teams into bad dives. Decide before you group who answers him.
check: Does anyone on your team have Teleport, and how close is their split pusher to your tower?
breaks: Wrong if a dragon or Baron is about to spawn on your side: then stay five and trade the tower for it.
basis: pro:Five in one lane puts you on the clock

when: the enemy has Baron buff
asks: how do we defend baron push
they have baron what do we do
say: Hold at the inhibitor tower and jump whoever steps up to hit it, or clear waves from range if you have no engage.
more: The tower is your extra player. They have to walk into its range to hit it, and that's when they're exposed.
The buff runs out. Every wave you clear is time off it.
check: Who on their team has to step forward to hit the tower, and does their engage champion still have Flash?
breaks: Wrong if they're hitting two lanes at once and you can't cover both: then give the outer one and hold the lane with your carry.
basis: pro:Fight where the tower helps

when: their mid is Galio
say: Hold the dive while Galio is missing from mid, his ultimate lands on your target, or go as soon as he shows in lane.
more: Hero's Entrance drops him on an ally from far away, with a shield for them and a knock-up for you, under their tower.
A dive needs to end quickly. If the target can stall for a few seconds, Galio decides it.
check: Is Galio visible in mid, is he level six, and can your mid keep him busy?
breaks: Wrong if he just used his ultimate somewhere else: then the dive is open until it's back.
basis: pro:A long-range ultimate answers the dive

when: an enemy died in the last 15 seconds
asks: we got a pick do we dive
can we take the tower now
say: Dive the next one only with a healthy tank to hold tower shots, or take the tower with the wave and leave.
more: A pick near their tower makes it four against five for them. A tank who can stand under it turns that into a second kill.
Without him, the tower does the work of the missing player.
check: How healthy is your tank, is there a wave with you, and how long is the death timer?
breaks: Wrong if their dead player respawns in a few seconds: then just hit the tower and go.
basis: pro:A dive needs someone to hold the tower

when: you have Baron buff
asks: how do we break their base
say: The moment their big wave-clear ultimate goes on minions, push that tower hard, or swap to the other lane if they still hold it.
more: A defending team that spends its strongest spell on a wave has nothing left for you. That's the opening.
Hit two lanes at once. They can only use that spell in one of them.
check: Which enemy holds the waves, and did you see his ultimate used?
breaks: Wrong if your own engage is on cooldown too: then keep pushing waves and wait for the next one.
basis: pro:Their wave clear is also their fight

when: your team destroyed an inhibitor in the last minute and a dragon spawns within a minute
say: Leave the base, recall and buy, then walk to dragon while super minions keep them home, or stay if their Nexus towers are falling.
more: The super minions do your pushing now. Someone on their team has to stay and clear them.
You arrive at the dragon with new items and they arrive a player short.
check: How much gold are you holding, and how many of them are alive?
breaks: Wrong if four of them are dead: then finish the game instead of resetting.
basis: pro:Let the super minions hold them

when: you have Baron buff and a dragon is up or spawns within a minute
asks: we have baron what do we do
where do we push with baron
say: Push mid, walk through their jungle and take the dragon as five, or keep sieging if an inhibitor is about to fall.
more: Baron makes waves hard to clear, so they're stuck in base while you take the dragon for free.
Skip it, and the next Baron comes without soul attached. That can be the difference in a long game.
Mid first, so the wave keeps them busy while you walk.
check: How long is left on the buff, and how many dragons do you have?
breaks: Wrong if the buff is almost out and nothing has fallen yet: then take one tower before anything else.
basis: pro:Baron buys the dragon too

when: you have Baron buff and three or more allies are dead
asks: only me and one other have baron
team's dead but I have baron
what do I do with baron alone
say: If you're buffed, take a side wave each and push two lanes, or group as one if their duelist beats you both.
more: The buff still makes your minions strong. Two lanes pushing at once is more than a hurt team can answer.
You don't need the fight. Towers taken this way are the Baron's payoff.
check: Who's alive on their team, and can any of them beat you alone?
breaks: Wrong if all five of them are alive and grouped: then push one wave to tower and wait for your team.
basis: pro:Two buffed players are still two lanes

when: your team is ahead and Baron is up
asks: how do we stop them farming
what do we do while ahead
say: Keep hovering Baron so their carry can't leave to farm, or back off and take a side tower if they stack the pit.
more: A team that's behind needs time for one more item. Each time you threaten Baron, they have to walk over.
Keep the river dark for them. Sooner or later they check a brush they shouldn't.
check: Is the pit warded for you, and which of their carries is one item away?
breaks: Wrong if their jungler is healthy and you'd have to commit to it: then don't turn a won game into a Smite contest.
basis: pro:Threaten Baron to stop the clock

when: your team is ahead
asks: how do we end with this team
how do we use the lead
say: Don't try to siege with an all-in team, start each dragon and make them walk to you, or dive a tower only with a big wave.
more: A team of engagers can't break a tower from range. In the open river, your knock-ups decide it.
They can't let you stack dragons, so they have to come into your range.
The soul fight is the one to plan your recalls around.
check: How many dragons do you have, and are your recalls done before the spawn?
breaks: Wrong if their team out-ranges you in the river as well: then wait for a pick before you start it.
basis: pro:Engage teams fight at objectives

when: you have the most kills in the game
asks: I'm fed what do I do
do I play safe or fight
say: Step up and hit whoever's closest while your tanks are beside you, or hold back if you can't see their divers.
more: When you're the team's damage, the team's job is keeping you alive and yours is to keep hitting.
Playing too far back wastes the lead. Their gold catches up while you wait.
The risk is going in where you can't see. One death with a big bounty gives it all back.
check: Where are their divers, and are your front-liners close enough to peel?
breaks: Wrong if both your Flash and your defensive spell are down: then stay a step further back for one fight.
basis: pro:The fed carry has to trust the peel

when: an objective spawns within two minutes
asks: should I flash for the kill
do I flash to finish him
he's one hit do I flash
say: Keep Flash and let him go if an objective is close, or Flash for it when the kill also wins you a tower.
more: A carry without Flash at the next fight is the one target their whole team looks for.
One more kill doesn't change much when you're ahead. Losing the fight at the objective does.
check: How long until the next objective, and does the kill open anything?
breaks: Wrong if he's their main carry with a big bounty: then that kill decides the fight before it starts.
basis: pro:Flash is for the next fight

when: you have six finished items
asks: we're ahead why aren't we winning
what do I do at six items
say: Your lead stops growing at full build, so force Baron or Elder now, or just keep waves pushed until your team is grouped.
more: Once you can't buy more, every minute only helps them. Their items catch up and yours don't move.
The lead has to become an objective while it's still a lead.
check: How many items do their carries have, and is your team grouped?
breaks: Wrong if their jungler is alive and your team isn't with you: then set up vision first and don't start it alone.
basis: pro:A full build is a deadline

when: two or more allies died in the last 20 seconds
asks: do I teleport to the fight
we lost the fight do I go
say: Teleport to your own tower and catch the wave, not to a forward ward, or go in only if their damage dealers are dead.
more: Teleporting into a lost fight puts you alone in the middle of them with no way out.
From your tower you stop the push, and they can't turn the fight into an inhibitor.
check: Who's still alive on both sides, and where would your Teleport land?
breaks: Wrong if your Teleport can land behind a team that's already low: then it wins the fight.
basis: pro:Don't Teleport into a lost fight

when: your team is behind in kills
asks: we're losing should I make a play
say: Keep your range and make them walk through your zone spells, or go in only on someone who's already slowed and alone.
more: A team built around range and walls loses when it gets impatient and walks into them.
They have to come to you to finish the game. That's when your slows and zones do their work.
If you're losing a side tower meanwhile, let your split pusher answer it.
check: Which of their engage spells are up, and can your team actually follow you in?
breaks: Wrong if they're about to take soul and you have no other way to stop it: then the fight has to happen, as five.
basis: pro:Impatience is how range teams lose

when: your team is behind and Baron is up
asks: we need something do we baron
say: Don't start it while their Teleport or long-range ultimate is up, ward it and look for a pick, or push a far wave first.
more: A team that's behind and starts Baron gets pinned in the pit by a team that's ahead.
If they can arrive from across the map, you just lose faster.
A pick first changes it. Then they arrive one short, and maybe without Smite.
check: Who on their team has Teleport or a global ultimate, and is their jungler visible?
breaks: Wrong if their jungler has just died: then it's the best chance you'll get, so go at once.
basis: pro:A desperate Baron loses faster

when: after 25:00
asks: do I go for the camp
say: Skip the lone camp on a dark side and catch a wave next to your team, or take it only with a ward behind it.
more: One player caught at a camp this late means a four against five, and they walk it into your base.
A side wave by a tower gives the same gold with a way out.
check: Is there a ward near that camp, and how many enemies are showing?
breaks: Wrong if four or more of them are showing on the far side: then the camp is free.
basis: pro:A camp can cost an inhibitor

when: two enemies died in the last 15 seconds, Baron is up and their jungler is alive
asks: we killed two do we baron
should we take towers or baron
their jungler's alive do we go
say: Start Baron if your main damage dealer is healthy and their jungler must walk through you, or take two towers if you're low.
more: Three players can't walk into a pit held by five. Their jungler has to try a steal alone.
It only works if you kill it fast. A slow Baron gives the dead time to come back.
check: How healthy is your carry, how long are the death timers, and is the pit warded by them?
breaks: Wrong if your own jungler is dead: then you have no Smite, so take the towers.
basis: pro:Two dead is a Baron if the damage is alive

when: three or more enemies died in the last 20 seconds and a dragon is up
asks: team's backing can I solo dragon
say: Ask one teammate to stay and zone before you solo it, or leave it if their support or jungler is alive nearby.
more: Alone on a dragon, anyone with a big damage spell can take the last hit from you. You have no Smite.
They'll also turn on you right after, with your team in base.
check: Which enemies are alive, and is your jungler close enough to Smite it?
breaks: Wrong if all five of them are dead: then take it alone and quickly.
basis: pro:A solo dragon needs a second body

asks: who stops the minions at our base
say: Leave one strong wave-clearer at home before you push to end, or commit all five only if their Teleport player is dead.
more: When both bases are open, one Teleport with a big wave ends the game while you're still hitting towers.
Send someone early by recall. A Teleport home spent in a panic is one you won't have for the answer.
check: Is their Teleport player alive, and how big is the wave at your base?
breaks: Wrong if their Nexus is already exposed and they have two or fewer alive: then all five finish it.
basis: pro:Someone stays home in a base race

asks: how do I start this fight
say: Wait in front of the pit until their big spells miss, then go straight in, or back off if you're poked below half.
more: A burst and poke team has one round of spells. Once those are thrown, they have little damage left for you.
Being at the objective first matters. They have to throw early, at bad angles, to get you off it.
check: Did you see their main spells used, and is your team close enough to follow?
breaks: Wrong if those spells hit your carries hard: then the fight is already lost, so give the objective.
basis: pro:Go in after the spells are thrown

asks: I missed everything what do I do
do I stay in the fight
say: If your opening spells miss, walk back until they're up again, or stay only behind a tank who's still standing.
more: Your damage comes all at once. With it on cooldown you're just a target standing in range.
Stepping out for a few seconds and coming back with spells ready often wins a fight that looked lost.
check: How long until your spells are back, and who's between you and their divers?
breaks: Wrong if your team has already committed and needs every body: then stay close and use whatever you have.
basis: pro:No spells, no reason to stand there

asks: their top is on me what do I do
I keep getting dove in fights
how do I teamfight as mage
say: Kite back toward your team so your big ultimate hits the group, or duel him only if he's alone and low.
more: While you fight one bruiser at the edge, your team is missing the spell that wins the fight.
Walking toward your team brings him into their range and brings you back to the middle.
check: Where's the rest of the fight, and is your ultimate ready?
breaks: Wrong if he's the only threat left alive: then deal with him first.
basis: pro:A mage in a side duel isn't in the fight

asks: should I go on their backline
how do I protect our carries
say: Walk into their divers and hit them before they reach your carries, or go for their back line only once the divers are spent.
more: Against a team that wants to jump in, the fight is won in front of your own carries.
Make them take damage on the way in. A diver who arrives at half health and misses by a step is dead.
Your carries should spread out, so one engage never hits both.
check: Who are their divers, and have they used their way in yet?
breaks: Wrong if they have no divers and just out-range you: then you have to be the one who goes in.
basis: pro:Meet the divers on the way in

asks: what do I do in this fight
say: While they're all hitting your jungler, slip past and get onto their carries, or peel instead if your carry is being dived.
more: Their damage is busy. That's the moment their back line is unguarded.
Once you're on the carries, they have to stop hitting your team and deal with you.
check: Where are their carries standing, and is anyone threatening yours?
breaks: Wrong if your jungler is about to die and you have the spell to save him: then use it there first.
basis: pro:Go past the fight they're busy with

when: Baron is up
asks: where do I stand for baron fight
say: Flank from the side only if you walked there unseen, or stand in front of your carry if their ward caught you.
more: A flank they don't know about makes their carries turn around. One they've seen is just you alone.
If you step on their control ward, assume they're already walking toward you.
check: Did you cross any ward on the way, and can your team start the fight when you go?
breaks: Wrong if your team has no other front line: then they need you between them and the enemy.
basis: pro:A seen flank is no flank

asks: where do I stand in fights
how do I not die first
say: Stand on the far side from where their diver was last seen, or stay next to your support if you've lost track of him.
more: A diver needs a short path to you. Put the whole fight between you and him and he arrives late and hurt.
A wall between you works too. He has to go around it.
check: Where was their flanker last seen, and which side is your front line on?
breaks: Wrong if that puts you alone and unwarded: then being near your team matters more than the angle.
basis: pro:Put the fight between you and the diver

when: their team has Rumble
asks: how do I fight into rumble
where do I stand vs rumble
rumble ult what do I do
we lose every fight to rumble
say: Stand apart from your other carry and walk out of the flames before fighting, or back off fully if you're both caught.
more: The Equalizer is a line of fire that burns and slows. A carry standing in it can't stay and deal damage.
If your two carries aren't in a row, it only takes one of you out of the fight.
Once it's been used, the next fight is much easier.
check: Has Rumble used his ultimate recently, and is there room to step sideways?
breaks: Wrong if you're in a narrow jungle path: then don't take the fight there at all.
basis: pro:One zone ultimate can't hit both carries

asks: when do I use realm of death
how do I use my ult in fights
say: Take their only engager into Realm of Death the moment he goes in, or take their fed carry if nobody else can reach him.
more: If one player starts every fight for them, removing him as he jumps leaves his team walking in with no follow-up.
He's also the one already next to you, so it's the easy cast.
The same button gets you out of their big ultimate if it's aimed at you.
check: Who starts their fights, and has he used his way in?
breaks: Wrong if they have several ways to engage: then the fed carry is the better target.
basis: pro:Remove the one who starts the fight

asks: who do I ult as trundle
say: Subjugate their biggest tank as the fight starts, or keep it to survive if their carries turn on you.
more: You steal health, armor and magic resist, so the tankier the target, the more you take and the softer he gets for your carries.
Pillar of Ice then cuts the fight in half, with their front line on your side of it.
check: Who's their tankiest player, and is he the one in front?
breaks: Wrong if they have no real tank: then use it on whoever you're fighting and focus on blocking a path with the pillar.
basis: pro:Their tank is your stats

asks: can I go on their adc
say: Hit the front with your team until their lockdown is used, then Killer Instinct onto a carry, or stay back all fight.
more: Killer Instinct puts you next to their team. If they still have a stun or a pull, you die before you shoot.
From behind your front line, your damage is nearly the same and you get to keep dealing it.
check: Which of their lockdown spells have been used, and is the carry you want alone?
breaks: Wrong if their carry is already low and isolated: then go straight for the kill.
basis: pro:The dive comes after their lockdown

when: a dragon or Baron spawns within a minute
asks: what do I do before dragon
how do I help at objectives
do I look for a kill
where should I be as leblanc
say: Sit out of sight near the pit, jump a carry and snap back, or hold Distortion to escape if their stun is close.
more: You don't need the kill. A carry at half health can't walk up to the objective, and your team gets it for free.
Distortion in and back out means you take nothing in return, as long as you don't use it into a wall.
Every brush they haven't checked is a place you might be. That slows their whole team down.
check: Where are their wards, and who on their team has a stun ready?
breaks: Wrong if they have vision of you: then you're just in front of your team, so poke from behind your tank.
basis: pro:Chunk them before the fight

asks: how do I play mundo jungle
say: Farm every camp and just turn up to objectives, or gank only a lane that's already past the middle.
more: You clear fast and scale with levels. A walk-up gank with one slow rarely kills anyone.
Recall as soon as the first clear is done, so you reach the crab with an item.
At dragons you're already useful. You shrug off the first stun and heal a lot with Maximum Dosage.
check: Are your camps up, and which objective is next?
breaks: Wrong if a lane is being dived and you're beside it: then go, you don't need to land anything to save it.
basis: pro:The farming jungler shows up to objectives

when: a dragon, grubs, Herald or Baron is up
asks: how do I help with objectives
what do I do at dragon
say: Stack spears on the objective and finish it with Rend when enemies show up, or drop it and kite if someone dives you.
more: Rend gets stronger with every spear, so you can finish a monster in one go. That works like a second Smite.
If you catch them out of position even briefly, an objective can be gone before they arrive.
check: How many spears are in it, and where's their jungler?
breaks: Wrong if you'd have to stand where their engage reaches you: then stay outside and let your jungler finish.
basis: pro:A second secure on the objective

when: between 14:00 and 25:00
asks: what do I do mid game
why do I do no damage
how do I play caitlyn after lane
say: Play for towers with traps and range until your next item, or fight only when a tank stands in front of you.
more: This is your weak part of the game. Your range still takes towers safely when theirs can't reach you.
Traps under a tower or in a narrow path give you a Headshot and hold them still for your team.
Don't stand alone in a side lane. One mistake here is how the other team gets back in.
check: Is there a front line with you, and which tower is lowest?
breaks: Wrong if you're well ahead from lane: then you can press fights earlier, while their carries are still behind.
basis: pro:Siege through the quiet minutes

asks: how do I lane against range
what do I do under tower
how do I play this lane
say: Clear every wave from range before it reaches your tower, or step up and hit theirs if their carry recalls.
more: A lane that wants to siege you gets nothing if the minions die before they arrive.
Later, the same wave clear lets you hold mid alone while your team moves.
Keep Satchel Charge to knock a diver away from you.
check: How much mana do you have, and is their jungler near?
breaks: Wrong if you're out of mana: then let one wave reach the tower and recall behind it.
basis: pro:Wave clear cancels a siege lane

asks: how do I play qiyana jungle
say: Farm to six and your first item, then look for fights near walls, or gank earlier only a lane with no Flash.
more: You live or die on staying ahead, so don't spend your early game on ganks that might fail.
Supreme Display of Talent stuns when it hits terrain, so fights in the jungle and river suit you.
Taking their camps with a pushing lane beside you gets you ahead quicker than ganking.
check: Are you level six, and which lanes have push?
breaks: Wrong if their team has several point-and-click stuns and you're behind: then stay with your team and follow up.
basis: pro:The assassin jungler has to stay ahead

asks: when do I use my ult
should I ult in from far
how do I gank with pantheon
say: Walk a flank and stun with Shield Vault on mobile targets, or use Grand Starfall to join a fight that's already started.
more: Grand Starfall shows where you land. Anyone with a dash or a speed-up just leaves.
Wasting it means they can move freely until it's back.
It's best for arriving across the map: a side lane being dived, or an objective fight you'd be late to.
check: Does your target have a dash or Flash, and is a fight starting somewhere?
breaks: Wrong if the target is already stunned or slowed by a teammate: then landing on him is fine.
basis: pro:A telegraphed ultimate needs a held target

when: their mid is an assassin and is level 6
asks: how do I survive the assassin
how do I lane vs assassin
say: Answer his all-in with your ultimate and keep Flash, then shove while his is down, or hug tower if yours is on cooldown.
more: He's fishing for your Flash. Once it's gone, the next all-in with his jungler kills you.
After his ultimate is used you control the wave, and your team gets the next objective from that.
Ask your support to stand near mid before objectives. That alone stops most of his tries.
check: Is your ultimate ready, where's his jungler, and how far are you from tower?
breaks: Wrong if his jungler is with him: then use everything, Flash included, and just live.
basis: pro:Trade the ultimate, keep the Flash

when: their mid deals magic damage and has the most kills in the game
asks: what do I build vs fed mage
say: Buy lifesteal if they chip you and never kill you in one go, or the magic shield item if one combo takes you to zero.
more: Against poke you don't die at once. You get worn down and then can't walk up to the objective. Healing fixes that.
A shield only helps if the problem is a single burst. Check how your last deaths happened.
check: Did you die to one combo or to several hits over time, and do you have a spell shield already?
breaks: Wrong if nobody on your team can peel and the mage is jumping on you: then the shield item comes first.
basis: pro:Heal through poke, shield against burst

asks: I keep getting stunned and dying
what do I buy vs their cc
say: Buy the cleanse item next if one stun is what kills you each fight, or stay on damage if you're dying to poke.
more: Late on, their whole plan can be one stun on you and everyone jumping in. Removing it is worth more than another damage item.
It does nothing against slow damage, so look at what's actually killing you.
check: What killed you in the last two fights, and do you already have Cleanse as a summoner spell?
breaks: Wrong if their lockdown is a knock-up: the item doesn't remove those, so buy something that keeps you alive instead.
basis: pro:One stun shouldn't end the game

when: their team has Cassiopeia
asks: what do I build vs cassio
say: Build the stasis item against Cassiopeia, since Miasma stops your dash, or get magic resist first if she isn't the fed one.
more: Miasma grounds you, so dashes and blinks don't work inside it. Stasis isn't a movement spell and still does.
It also lets you sit out Petrifying Gaze and the burst that follows.
check: Is Cassiopeia their main damage, and how close are you to affording it?
breaks: Wrong if the one killing you deals physical damage: then armor or more distance is the answer.
basis: pro:Stasis works where dashes don't

when: your team is ahead and a soul dragon or Baron is next
say: Buy the revive item before that fight so you can go in first twice, or finish your damage item if you're the main threat.
more: The one who starts the fight usually dies. With a revive, they have to kill you twice while your carries shoot.
It lets you force the fights with the big rewards instead of waiting for a perfect opening.
check: Who starts fights for your team, and how far are you from the item?
breaks: Wrong if you're behind and die before reaching anyone: then health and resistances do more.
basis: pro:The engager buys a second life

asks: how do I play smolder early
say: Hit champions with spells and last-hit with your Q for stacks every wave, or fight early only with your jungler there.
more: Each stack makes your basic abilities hit harder, so a slow first few minutes costs you for the rest of the game.
Teams will send someone who can jump on you to slow that down. Give up a minion before you give up a kill.
With enough stacks and items you poke teams down before objectives, and they have to engage badly.
check: Who's in lane against you, and can he reach you when you step up to last-hit?
breaks: Wrong if your team is losing everywhere and needs you now: then group and use your ultimate in fights with what you have.
basis: pro:Stacks first, fights later
